The giant forests of Gloom remained untouched for many years. That was until a logging company decided it to be the perfect place to exploit. But little did they know that these forests were.. Protected.

Gloom environment

> Weather

Gloom can experience Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, or Minefield weather by default.

> Moon Exclusive Content

Outside Ambience

On Gloom you can hear ambience that plays outside.

Outside Ambience

Time Multiplier

The player's clock is hidden while on Gloom. However, time progresses at its normal speed.

Gloom's Fog

Gloom's exterior and interior has a foggy-like effect that reduces visibility. The interior fog can increase or decrease in intensity throughout the day.

Gloom's Map & Detonator

In the cave where the main entrance can be found, a map displays the location of all cave entrances and has a X on it.
This X is a detonator that is located next to one of cabins (fire exits) on the exterior. The easiest way to reach it is to walk almost directly southwest from the ship and then follow the lanterns to the detonator. Pushing this detonator causes two fire exits, which are the left most and right most cave entrances on the map respectively, to become accessible from the exterior. However, pushing this detonator also causes a cave-in that renders the main entrance and the cave it's in to be inaccessible from the exterior.

Altar (Mysterious Object's Slot)

Gloom's exterior also has an altar where a mysterious object can be placed. To reach it, follow the pathway behind the ship and walk along the edge of the water, turn left near the big tree and walk towards a lantern, turn right and walk to the second lantern, and walk a little straight and turn left past the second lantern. This mysterious object is a Brooding seed that can be found in a hidden chamber on the exterior of Berunah. Placing the seed will cause a warning message to appear that says "A Cosmic Entity of unknown power has turned it's focus towards this planet".

This dramatically alters the terrain on the exterior, causes several tentacles to appear on the exterior that deal 20 damage per hit on contact, visually alters the interior, and causes the Assimilated Growth to almost immediately spawn in the interior when landing on the moon in the future. This persists until players are fired unless seeds are also placed on the exteriors of Etern, Filitrios, Fission-C, and Utril, in which case the changes become permanent on that save file.

> Progression

Unlocked By

Inserting the Gloom videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interiors of Acidir, Alcatras, Chasm, or Junic into the projector in Galetry.

Dreck: "Floppy disk" that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.
Filitrios: Filitrios videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.
Junic: Junic videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.
Utril: Utril videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.

Possessed Walkie-Talkie
